needed.suggestion: Install a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the marked crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing a wide road.
Install dropped kerbs at both ends of the marked crossing to improve accessibility for wheelchair users and pedestrians with mobility aids.
Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.
